articles.title: 精氨酸治疗镰状细胞病急性疼痛发作：STArT随机临床试验
articles.originalTitle: Arginine Therapy for Sickle Cell Disease Acute Pain Episodes: The STArT Randomized Clinical Trial.
articles.abstract: IMPORTANCE: Acute pain episodes are the leading cause of emergency department visits and hospitalizations for patients with sickle cell disease (SCD), yet US Food and Drug Administration-approved drugs for acute pain episodes are lacking. During acute pain episodes, patients develop acute arginine deficiency associated with longer time to crisis resolution and greater total parenteral opioid use. Multiple single-center, phase 2 randomized clinical trials have shown that arginine is safe, is opioid sparing, improves cardiopulmonary function, and reduces length of hospital stay. OBJECTIVE: To determine the efficacy and safety of intravenous arginine for SCD acute pain episodes. DESIGN, SETTING, AND PARTICIPANTS: Prospective, phase 3, double-blind randomized clinical trial conducted between June 21, 2021, and June 13, 2024, in 10 US children's hospitals enrolling patients aged 3 to 21 years presenting to the emergency department with SCD acute pain episodes requiring parenteral opioids. INTERVENTIONS: Patients were randomized to receive intravenous arginine (200 mg/kg followed by 100 mg/kg every 8 hours until discharge; n = 129) or saline placebo (n = 142). MAIN OUTCOMES AND MEASURES: The primary outcome was time to crisis resolution, defined as hours from initial study drug delivery to last intravenous opioid dose. Secondary outcomes included total parenteral opioid use (intravenous morphine equivalents in milligrams per kilogram from first study drug dose to last intravenous opioid dose), pain scores, and patient-reported outcomes. RESULTS: Of 274 randomized participants, 271 received study drug; the mean age was 14.3 years (SD, 4.3 years), 51% were male, and 92% were Black. The trial was halted early for futility, as time to crisis resolution was similar in those receiving arginine vs placebo (median, 60.8 hours [IQR, 34.8-109.0 hours] vs 65.8 hours [IQR, 31.1-111.1 hours], respectively; absolute difference, 7.2 hours; 95% CI, -21.6 to 35.9 hours). No significant differences were seen in total parenteral opioid use, pain scores, patient-reported outcomes, or safety events. CONCLUSIONS AND RELEVANCE: Arginine therapy did not shorten time to crisis resolution compared with placebo among children and young adults with SCD acute pain episodes. TRIAL REGISTRATION: ClinicalTrials.gov Identifier: NCT04839354.

sections.heading: IMPORTANCE
sections.text: 急性疼痛发作是镰状细胞病（SCD）患者急诊就诊和住院的主要原因，但美国食品药品监督管理局批准的用于急性疼痛发作的药物仍然缺乏。在急性疼痛发作期间，患者会出现急性精氨酸缺乏，这与危机解决时间延长和肠外阿片类药物总用量增加相关。多项单中心、2期随机临床试验表明，精氨酸是安全的，可节省阿片类药物，改善心肺功能，并缩短住院时间。

sections.heading: OBJECTIVE
sections.text: 确定静脉注射精氨酸治疗SCD急性疼痛发作的有效性和安全性。

sections.heading: DESIGN, SETTING, AND PARTICIPANTS
sections.text: 前瞻性、3期、双盲随机临床试验，于2021年6月21日至2024年6月13日在美国10家儿童医院进行，纳入年龄3至21岁、因SCD急性疼痛发作就诊急诊科并需要肠外阿片类药物的患者。

sections.heading: INTERVENTIONS
sections.text: 患者被随机分配接受静脉注射精氨酸（200 mg/kg，随后每8小时100 mg/kg，直至出院；n = 129）或生理盐水安慰剂（n = 142）。

sections.heading: MAIN OUTCOMES AND MEASURES
sections.text: 主要结局是危机解决时间，定义为从首次研究药物给药到最后一次静脉注射阿片类药物的小时数。次要结局包括肠外阿片类药物总用量（从首次研究药物剂量到最后一次静脉注射阿片类药物的静脉注射吗啡等效剂量，以mg/kg计）、疼痛评分和患者报告结局。

sections.heading: RESULTS
sections.text: 在274名随机参与者中，271名接受了研究药物；平均年龄为14.3岁（SD，4.3岁），51%为男性，92%为黑人。试验因无效而提前停止，因为接受精氨酸与安慰剂的患者危机解决时间相似（中位数分别为60.8小时[IQR，34.8-109.0小时] vs 65.8小时[IQR，31.1-111.1小时]；绝对差异为7.2小时；95% CI，-21.6至35.9小时）。在肠外阿片类药物总用量、疼痛评分、患者报告结局或安全事件方面未观察到显著差异。

sections.heading: CONCLUSIONS AND RELEVANCE
sections.text: 与安慰剂相比，精氨酸治疗并未缩短患有SCD急性疼痛发作的儿童和年轻成人的危机解决时间。

sections.heading: TRIAL REGISTRATION
sections.text: ClinicalTrials.gov标识符：NCT04839354。

articles.question: 镰状细胞病急性疼痛发作是急诊就诊和住院的主要原因，但目前缺乏FDA批准的针对性药物。该研究是首个多中心、双盲、随机对照试验，评估精氨酸在急性疼痛发作中的疗效，结果不支持其常规使用，对临床实践具有重要指导意义。
articles.conclusion: 在儿童和年轻成人镰状细胞病急性疼痛发作患者中，静脉注射精氨酸与安慰剂相比，未缩短疼痛发作缓解时间。
articles.clinical: 该研究结果不支持在镰状细胞病急性疼痛发作中常规使用静脉精氨酸作为辅助治疗。 麻醉科医师在围术期或急诊处理镰状细胞病疼痛时，不应期望精氨酸能减少阿片类药物需求或加速疼痛缓解。 对于镰状细胞病患者，应继续遵循现有疼痛管理指南，优化阿片类药物使用并关注其他辅助治疗。

articles.title: 氯胺酮给药与重大癌症手术后死亡率：一项倾向评分匹配的基于人群的研究
articles.originalTitle: Ketamine administration and postoperative mortality after major cancer surgery: a propensity-matched population-based study.
articles.abstract: BACKGROUND: Ketamine is commonly used perioperatively as an anaesthetic and analgesic adjunct and has demonstrated potential antitumour effects in preclinical studies. However, clinical and epidemiological data on its association with long-term outcomes after oncologic surgery remain limited. METHODS: We conducted a retrospective cohort study using the TriNetX US Collaborative Network, including adults (>/=18 yr) undergoing major solid tumour cancer surgery between January 1, 2014, and April 1, 2023. The primary exposure was ketamine administration on the day of surgery. Propensity score matching (1:1) was performed using patient characteristics, comorbidities, oncologic diagnoses, and surgery type. The primary outcome was 3-yr mortality, and the secondary outcome was 5-yr mortality. RESULTS: Among 176 149 eligible patients, 29 547 matched pairs were analysed. Perioperative ketamine administration was not associated with lower 3-yr mortality (16.7% vs 16.0%; hazard ratio [HR], 1.04; 95% confidence interval [CI], 1.00-1.09; q=0.187). There was no difference in 5-yr mortality. Across sensitivity and subgroup analyses by cancer type and perioperative exposures, ketamine was not associated with improved survival after adjustment for multiple comparisons. In an exploratory analysis, ketamine exposure was associated with a lower risk of a composite of surrogate markers suggestive of cancer progression or advanced disease, including initiation of chemotherapy, radiotherapy, or palliative care >/=6 months after surgery (HR, 0.82; 95% CI, 0.74-0.92; q=0.013). CONCLUSIONS: In this research network study, perioperative ketamine use was not associated with reduced mortality after major cancer surgery. This finding aligns with previous large-scale studies showing no long-term survival benefit for specific anaesthetic agents in oncologic surgery.

sections.heading: BACKGROUND
sections.text: 氯胺酮在围手术期常作为麻醉和镇痛的辅助药物使用，并在临床前研究中显示出潜在的抗肿瘤作用。然而，关于其在肿瘤手术后长期结局方面的临床和流行病学数据仍然有限。

sections.heading: METHODS
sections.text: 我们使用TriNetX美国协作网络进行了一项回顾性队列研究，纳入2014年1月1日至2023年4月1日期间接受大型实体瘤癌症手术的成人（≥18岁）。主要暴露是手术当天的氯胺酮给药。使用患者特征、合并症、肿瘤诊断和手术类型进行倾向评分匹配（1:1）。主要结局是3年死亡率，次要结局是5年死亡率。

sections.heading: RESULTS
sections.text: 在176 149名符合条件的患者中，分析了29 547对匹配患者。围手术期氯胺酮给药与较低的3年死亡率无关（16.7% vs 16.0%；风险比[HR]，1.04；95%置信区间[CI]，1.00-1.09；q=0.187）。5年死亡率无差异。在按癌症类型和围手术期暴露进行的敏感性和亚组分析中，经多重比较校正后，氯胺酮与生存改善无关。在一项探索性分析中，氯胺酮暴露与提示癌症进展或晚期疾病的替代标志物复合终点风险较低相关，包括术后≥6个月开始化疗、放疗或姑息治疗（HR，0.82；95% CI，0.74-0.92；q=0.013）。

sections.heading: CONCLUSIONS
sections.text: 在这项研究网络研究中，围手术期使用氯胺酮与大型癌症手术后死亡率降低无关。这一发现与之前大规模研究一致，即特定麻醉药物在肿瘤手术中没有长期生存获益。

articles.title: 评估吸入麻醉、全凭静脉麻醉和椎管内麻醉用于单一手术的碳足迹：一项前瞻性观察性研究
articles.originalTitle: Assessing the carbon footprint of inhalation anaesthesia, total intravenous anaesthesia, and spinal anaesthesia for a single surgical procedure: a prospective observational study.
articles.abstract: BACKGROUND: Healthcare contributes substantially to greenhouse gas emissions (GHG), and anaesthesia is recognised as a high-impact sector. Evidence comparing the carbon footprint of anaesthetic techniques remains limited, particularly in Europe. We quantified carbon dioxide equivalent (CO(2)e) emissions from inhalation anaesthesia with low-flow sevoflurane, TIVA and spinal anaesthesia during operative hysteroscopy. METHODS: We performed a prospective GHG-focused life cycle assessment of consecutive patients undergoing operative hysteroscopy in a French university hospital. For each case, we recorded gases, drugs, medical devices, electricity consumption, and their respective costs. Carbon footprints were calculated by Assistance Publique - Hopitaux de Paris Carebone(R) platform and expressed in CO(2)e. RESULTS: We included 123 participants: 72 underwent inhalation anaesthesia, 22 underwent TIVA, and 29 underwent spinal anaesthesia. Total carbon emissions differed significantly across techniques: median emissions were 10.8 kgCO(2)e [9.1-12.6] for inhalation anaesthesia, 6.6 kgCO(2)e [6.4-6.9] for TIVA and 5.5 kgCO(2)e [5.3-6.2] for spinal anaesthesia (P<0.001). Volatile anaesthetics were the main contributors for inhalation anaesthesia, pharmaceuticals for TIVA and single-use devices for spinal anaesthesia. Electricity consumption was similar across groups. CONCLUSIONS: Spinal anaesthesia demonstrated the lowest carbon footprint. TIVA represented the lowest-carbon option for general anaesthesia techniques, whereas inhalation anaesthesia yielded the highest CO(2)e emissions despite low-flow delivery. These findings highlight the mitigation potential of anaesthetic choice even in low-complexity procedures.

sections.heading: BACKGROUND
sections.text: 医疗保健行业对温室气体排放（GHG）贡献巨大，麻醉被认为是高影响领域。比较麻醉技术碳足迹的证据仍然有限，尤其是在欧洲。我们量化了宫腔镜手术中低流量七氟烷吸入麻醉、全凭静脉麻醉（TIVA）和蛛网膜下腔麻醉的二氧化碳当量（CO(2)e）排放。

sections.heading: METHODS
sections.text: 我们对法国一所大学医院连续接受宫腔镜手术的患者进行了一项前瞻性的、以温室气体为重点的生命周期评估。对于每个病例，我们记录了气体、药物、医疗设备、电力消耗及其各自成本。碳足迹由巴黎公立医院集团（Assistance Publique - Hopitaux de Paris）的Carenbone(R)平台计算，并以CO(2)e表示。

sections.heading: RESULTS
sections.text: 我们纳入了123名参与者：72名接受吸入麻醉，22名接受TIVA，29名接受蛛网膜下腔麻醉。不同技术的总碳排放量存在显著差异：吸入麻醉的中位排放量为10.8 kgCO(2)e [9.1-12.6]，TIVA为6.6 kgCO(2)e [6.4-6.9]，蛛网膜下腔麻醉为5.5 kgCO(2)e [5.3-6.2]（P<0.001）。挥发性麻醉药是吸入麻醉的主要贡献者，药品是TIVA的主要贡献者，一次性设备是蛛网膜下腔麻醉的主要贡献者。各组间的电力消耗相似。

sections.heading: CONCLUSIONS
sections.text: 蛛网膜下腔麻醉的碳足迹最低。TIVA是全身麻醉技术中碳足迹最低的选择，而吸入麻醉尽管采用低流量输送，其CO(2)e排放量最高。这些发现强调了麻醉选择在低复杂性手术中的减排潜力。

articles.title: 经颅电刺激与术后患者谵妄：一项随机临床试验
articles.originalTitle: Transcranial Electrical Stimulation and Delirium Among Postoperative Patients: A Randomized Clinical Trial.
articles.abstract: IMPORTANCE: Postoperative delirium (POD) occurs as a significant complication after elective surgery. OBJECTIVE: To investigate the modulation of delirium incidence by transcranial electric stimulation (tES). DESIGN, SETTING, AND PARTICIPANTS: A double-blind, sham-controlled randomized clinical trial (Modulating Delirium Through Stimulation [MODEST]) was conducted at University Medicine Greifswald, Germany, from February 8, 2024, to January 15, 2025. Patients were aged 65 years or older who were scheduled to undergo elective surgery. Exclusion criteria were any history of neurological or psychiatric disease, or intake of central nervous system-active medication. Data were analyzed from June 10, 2025, to June 5, 2026. INTERVENTION: alpha-Transcranial alternating current stimulation (tACS) of the salience network, transcranial direct current stimulation (tDCS) of the frontoparietal network (dosing: 20 minutes, 2 mA), or sham, in the postanesthesia care unit (PACU) after major elective surgery. MAIN OUTCOMES AND MEASURES: The primary outcome was POD incidence in the ward during 1 of up to 5 postoperative days for the comparison of tACS vs the sham group. The secondary outcomes included POD in the ward for the comparison of tDCS vs sham group, POD in PACU, POD severity and motor type, and postoperative pain. Prespecified subgroup analyses opted to test the dependence of POD incidence on age, sex, duration, and type of surgery, baseline cognitive function, and preoperative pain levels. RESULTS: A total of 225 patients (mean [SD] age, 73.0 [6.0] years; 59.6% [134] male) were randomly assigned to tACS (n = 68), tDCS (n = 83), or sham stimulation (n = 74). No substantial between group differences were observed for POD incidence in ward (tACS, 11.5% [6 of 52]; tDCS, 14.3% [9 of 63]; sham, 9.2% [6 of 65]; tACS vs sham: odds ratio [OR], 1.60 [95% CI, 0.47-5.46]; P = .45; tDCS vs sham: OR, 1.51 [95% CI, 0.49-4.68]; P = .47) or in PACU (tACS, 14.6% [7 of 48]; tDCS, 21.4% [12 of 56]; sham, 21.7% [13 of 60]; tACS vs sham: OR, 0.95 [95% CI, 0.38-2.36]; P = .91; tDCS vs sham: OR, 0.91 [95% CI, 0.36-2.30]; P = .83). Further secondary analyses of POD severity and motor type, and modulation of pain levels, did not show any substantial difference between stimulation groups. Prespecified subgroup analyses revealed different modulation of POD incidence in PACU depending on duration of surgery (OR, 0.15 [95% CI, 0.02-0.97]; P = .046), indicating that tACS may reduce POD incidence for patients with longer surgery (absolute risk difference for POD in the tACS compared with the sham group, for a surgical duration of 3 to 5 hours of -26.6% to -46.5%). Ratings of adverse events did not differ between groups (incidence rate ratio, 2.3 [95% CI, 0.8-6.5]), and no serious adverse events were reported. CONCLUSIONS AND RELEVANCE: In this randomized clinical trial of tES for POD, there was no evidence for a uniform effect of postoperative tES on the incidence of POD, but it suggested a benefit of parietal alpha oscillatory enhancement for patients with longer surgery. Future research has to test the specific effect on vulnerable groups, examine the optimal timing for tES application to modulate POD, and investigate the value of personalizing tES parameters. TRIAL REGISTRATION: German Clinical Trials Register: DRKS00033703.

sections.text: 在大型择期手术后的麻醉后监护室（PACU）中，对显著性网络进行α经颅交流电刺激（tACS），对额顶网络进行经颅直流电刺激（tDCS）（剂量：20分钟，2 mA），或进行假刺激。

sections.heading: MAIN OUTCOMES AND MEASURES
sections.text: 主要结局是术后最多5天中1天病房内POD的发生率，用于比较tACS与假刺激组。次要结局包括tDCS与假刺激组比较的病房内POD、PACU内POD、POD严重程度和运动类型，以及术后疼痛。预设亚组分析旨在检验POD发生率对年龄、性别、手术持续时间和类型、基线认知功能和术前疼痛水平的依赖性。

sections.heading: RESULTS
sections.text: 共有225名患者（平均[SD]年龄，73.0 [6.0]岁；59.6% [134]为男性）被随机分配到tACS组（n = 68）、tDCS组（n = 83）或假刺激组（n = 74）。病房内POD发生率未观察到组间实质性差异（tACS，11.5% [6/52]；tDCS，14.3% [9/63]；假刺激，9.2% [6/65]；tACS vs 假刺激：比值比[OR]，1.60 [95% CI，0.47-5.46]；P = .45；tDCS vs 假刺激：OR，1.51 [95% CI，0.49-4.68]；P = .47）或PACU内（tACS，14.6% [7/48]；tDCS，21.4% [12/56]；假刺激，21.7% [13/60]；tACS vs 假刺激：OR，0.95 [95% CI，0.38-2.36]；P = .91；tDCS vs 假刺激：OR，0.91 [95% CI，0.36-2.30]；P = .83）。对POD严重程度和运动类型以及疼痛水平调节的进一步次要分析未显示刺激组之间存在任何实质性差异。预设亚组分析显示，PACU内POD发生率的调节因手术持续时间而异（OR，0.15 [95% CI，0.02-0.97]；P = .046），表明tACS可能降低手术时间较长患者的POD发生率（与假刺激组相比，tACS组POD的绝对风险差异，对于3至5小时的手术持续时间为-26.6%至-46.5%）。不良事件评级在组间无差异（发生率比，2.3 [95% CI，0.8-6.5]），且未报告严重不良事件。

sections.heading: CONCLUSIONS AND RELEVANCE
sections.text: 在这项关于tES治疗POD的随机临床试验中，没有证据表明术后tES对POD发生率有一致性效应，但提示对手术时间较长的患者，顶叶α振荡增强可能有益。未来研究需要测试对易感人群的特异性效应，检查tES应用调节POD的最佳时机，并探讨个性化tES参数的价值。

articles.question: 术后谵妄是老年手术患者常见的严重并发症，目前缺乏有效的预防手段。本研究探索了无创经颅电刺激（tES）作为潜在干预措施的效果，尽管主要结果为阴性，但为未来研究提供了重要线索，特别是针对特定亚组（如手术时间较长者）的个体化刺激方案可能值得进一步探索。
articles.conclusion: 在225例老年择期手术患者中，术后经颅电刺激（tACS或tDCS）与假刺激相比，未显著降低病房或PACU中术后谵妄的发生率，但亚组分析提示tACS可能对手术时间较长（3-5小时）的患者有潜在获益。
articles.clinical: 本研究未发现术后tES对POD发生率的整体效应，因此目前不建议将tES作为常规预防POD的手段。 亚组分析提示tACS可能对手术时间较长（3-5小时）的患者有潜在获益，但该结果需谨慎解读，尚需进一步验证。 未来研究应关注特定高危人群、优化刺激时机和参数，并探索个体化tES方案。

articles.methods: 术后谵妄（POD）是择期手术后常见的并发症，尤其在老年患者中，与不良预后相关。经颅电刺激（tES）作为一种无创神经调控技术，可能通过调节大脑网络活动来影响谵妄的发生。本研究旨在评估两种tES模式（α-tACS和tDCS）对POD发生率的影响。
articles.results: 共225例患者（平均[SD]年龄73.0[6.0]岁，59.6%[134]为男性）被随机分配至tACS（n=68）、tDCS（n=83）或假刺激（n=74）。病房POD发生率：tACS组11.5%（6/52），tDCS组14.3%（9/63），假刺激组9.2%（6/65）；tACS vs 假刺激：OR 1.60（95% CI 0.47-5.46），P=0.45；tDCS vs 假刺激：OR 1.51（95% CI 0.49-4.68），P=0.47。PACU内POD发生率：tACS组14.6%（7/48），tDCS组21.4%（12/56），假刺激组21.7%（13/60）；tACS vs 假刺激：OR 0.95（95% CI 0.38-2.36），P=0.91；tDCS vs 假刺激：OR 0.91（95% CI 0.36-2.30），P=0.83。次要分析（POD严重程度、运动亚型、疼痛水平）未显示组间显著差异。预设亚组分析显示，根据手术时长，PACU内POD发生率存在不同调节作用（OR 0.15 [95% CI 0.02-0.97]，P=0.046），提示tACS可能降低手术时间较长（3-5小时）患者的POD发生率（绝对风险差异为-26.6%至-46.5%）。不良事件评级组间无差异（发生率比2.3 [95% CI 0.8-6.5]），未报告严重不良事件。

articles.title: 丙泊酚对前包钦格复合体GABA能神经传递的剂量依赖性效应及其对呼吸节律的影响
articles.originalTitle: Dose-dependent Effects of Propofol on GABAergic Neurotransmission in the Pre-Botzinger Complex and Its Consequences on Respiratory Rhythm.
articles.abstract: BACKGROUND: Propofol acts primarily through gamma-aminobutyric acid type A receptor-dependent central inhibition, while local inhibitory microcircuits in the pre-Botzinger complex (pre-BotC) exert bidirectional control over respiratory rhythm. Although propofol is widely recognized as a simple respiratory depressant, it remains unclear whether propofol mimics endogenous inhibitory signaling to disrupt pre-BotC circuit function in a complex, dose-related manner. This study aimed to test the hypothesis that propofol modulates pre-BotC activity via dose-dependent reshaping of local inhibitory microcircuits rather than producing only monotonic respiratory suppression. METHODS: Using a mouse model, the authors combined whole-body plethysmography, optogenetic manipulation of pre-BotC gamma-aminobutyric acid-mediated (GABAergic) neurons, conditional VGAT knockout, and patch clamp electrophysiology in acute medullary slices to examine how propofol modulates respiratory rhythm and inhibitory microcircuit activity. RESULTS: Propofol induced dose-dependent, bidirectional respiratory effects ranging from mild excitation to marked suppression with increasing anesthetic depth. These changes correlated with concordant, dose-dependent excitatory and inhibitory effects of the drug on glutamatergic neurons in the pre-BotC. Light intensity-dependent, sustained optogenetic activation of GABAergic neurons in the pre-BotC recapitulates the dose-dependent, bidirectional effects of propofol on respiratory activity, while concurrent propofol administration and GABAergic pre-BotC activation act synergistically to induce respiratory arrest. Selective ablation of GABAergic neurons in the pre-BotC increased respiratory rate in awake animals, facilitated respiratory recovery after a single propofol bolus but increased the incidence of apnea during continuous propofol infusion. CONCLUSIONS: These results suggest a dose-dependent bidirectional effect of propofol on respiratory drive via the modulation of GABAergic neurons in the pre-Botzinger complex.

sections.heading: BACKGROUND
sections.text: 丙泊酚主要通过γ-氨基丁酸A型受体依赖性中枢抑制发挥作用，而前包钦格复合体（pre-BotC）中的局部抑制性微环路对呼吸节律进行双向调控。尽管丙泊酚被广泛认为是一种单纯的呼吸抑制剂，但丙泊酚是否模拟内源性抑制信号以复杂、剂量相关的方式破坏pre-BotC回路功能仍不清楚。本研究旨在检验以下假设：丙泊酚通过剂量依赖性重塑局部抑制性微环路来调节pre-BotC活性，而非仅产生单调的呼吸抑制。

sections.heading: METHODS
sections.text: 使用小鼠模型，作者结合全身体积描记法、pre-BotC中γ-氨基丁酸能（GABAergic）神经元的光遗传学操作、条件性VGAT敲除以及急性延髓切片中的膜片钳电生理学，来检查丙泊酚如何调节呼吸节律和抑制性微环路活性。

sections.heading: RESULTS
sections.text: 丙泊酚诱导剂量依赖性的双向呼吸效应，随着麻醉深度的增加，从轻度兴奋到显著抑制。这些变化与药物对pre-BotC中谷氨酸能神经元的剂量依赖性兴奋和抑制效应一致。光强度依赖性的、持续的pre-BotC中GABA能神经元的光遗传学激活重现了丙泊酚对呼吸活动的剂量依赖性双向效应，而同时给予丙泊酚和激活pre-BotC GABA能神经元协同作用，导致呼吸暂停。选择性消融pre-BotC中的GABA能神经元增加了清醒动物的呼吸频率，促进了单次丙泊酚推注后的呼吸恢复，但在持续丙泊酚输注期间增加了呼吸暂停的发生率。

sections.heading: CONCLUSIONS
sections.text: 这些结果表明，丙泊酚通过调节前包钦格复合体中的GABA能神经元，对呼吸驱动产生剂量依赖性的双向效应。
